title: psephellus arpensis
intro: Psephellus arpensis, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Psephellus arpensis include its ability to soothe muscle cramps, reduce menstrual pain, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
